name: tmux-chrome-bridge
title: Tmux Chrome Tab Groups
description: Switch Chrome tab groups synced with tmux windows
author: keyolk

commands.name: switch-tab-group
commands.title: Switch Tab Group
commands.description: List and switch Chrome tab groups

commands.name: switch-tab
commands.title: Switch Tab
commands.description: Switch tabs in the tab group of the current tmux window

commands.name: switch-tmux-window
commands.title: Switch Tmux Window
commands.description: List and switch tmux windows across all sessions

commands.name: swap-window
commands.title: Swap Terminal and Chrome Window
commands.description: Swap the position/size of the tmux terminal window and the front Chrome window

commands.name: distribute-windows
commands.title: Distribute Terminal and Chrome Windows
commands.description: If the terminal and Chrome overlap on one display, move Chrome to a free display

commands.name: window-layout
commands.title: Apply Window Layout
commands.description: Apply a saved left/right app workspace layout

commands.name: clean-tabs
commands.title: Clean Ungrouped Tabs
commands.description: Move ungrouped Chrome tabs into the reserved native group

commands.name: clean-orphan-groups
commands.title: Clean Orphan Groups
commands.description: Remove Chrome tab groups that have no matching tmux window

commands.name: clean-stale-tabs
commands.title: Clean Stale Tabs
commands.description: Close all verified ended PR and completed authentication tabs

commands.name: review-stale-tabs
commands.title: Review Stale Tabs
commands.description: Review and close ended GitHub PR and completed authentication tabs

commands.name: auto-clean-tabs
commands.title: Auto Clean Tabs
commands.description: Every hour, close idle stale tabs and sweep idle ungrouped tabs into the native group

preferences.name: idleMinutes
preferences.title: Idle Minutes
preferences.description: Only touch tabs not accessed for at least this many minutes
